name: SIFT 키포인트 포렌식
description: 사용합니다 Scale-Invariant Feature Transform keypoints 감지하기 위해 duplicated and manipulated image regions.
algorithm: SIFT-Based Copy-Move Forgery Detection with Geometric Verification
mechanism: 추출합니다 SIFT keypoints and descriptors from the image, then matches them to find duplicated regions. Geometric verification using RANSAC eliminates false matches.
parameters: Octaves: 4, Scales: 5, Descriptor: 128-dim, Matching: ratio test (0.6), Verification: RANSAC
source: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Robust 복사-이동 위조 감지 invariant to scaling, rotation, and 조명 changes

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• 스케일 및 회전 불변
• 기하학적 검증으로 오매치 감소
• 컴퓨터 비전에서 검증됨
• 부분 가림 처리 가능
limitations:
• 계산 비용이 높음
• Struggles with smooth/textureless regions
• Memory intensive for many keypoints
• Parameter 민감도
